because.generation.producer: SFlow builds the convergence report itself from the specification, the plan and the code.
because.approval.automatic: Convergence folds into the code approval, so SFlow approves a clean spec-versus-code check itself; a gap goes back to the code step or to a person's decision.

because.testEvidenceFrom: It runs the repository's tests itself, reusing the code step's run on unchanged code, so a failing test goes back to the code step on its own (D1) instead of only reading the code step's results.
